paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Globular Cluster R parameter bound on axion-photon coupling: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, valid for axion mass below a few keV. This is a stellar astrophysics bound (not DM haloscope), so no DM density assumption. The limit is essentially mass-independent over a wide range (ma below ~10 keV). Data points are approximate representations of the flat bound; the paper does not provide a tabulated mass-vs-coupling curve.
